card.name: Sentence-ending punctuation before new section
card.fires_on: Periods and opening parentheses that end a sentence or clause in drug-label text, right before a new sentence, a section number like (5.3), or a new topic begins.

modes.label: Period before next sentence
modes.description: A full stop closing a sentence, with a new sentence or heading starting next.

modes.label: Open parenthesis for cross-reference
modes.description: An opening bracket after a sentence end, leading into a section number or a citation.

modes.label: Parenthesis after a value
modes.description: An opening bracket after a measurement that introduces a converted value.
